answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops sybil farming at the gate. To claim one of 50 work slots, an agent burns a 200 POA deposit, and the slot is locked for 20 epochs. A faker minting 100 identities must burn 20,000 POA up front, like shale piled layer upon layer until the dune of cost collapses. Honest agents pay 200 once, keep the slot, and earn undiluted rewards; the marble floor is solid for one real worker and quicksand for a hundred fakes.
